{{Otheruses|Gant}}
'''Gant''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Gant heard a rumor that inserting a non-ferrous material between the locking pincers of [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]] could break the connection, allowing a prisoner to escape.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
